title: The best of both worlds: MemoryBO for rapid optimization, Kinetics360 for mechanistic understanding.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
The best of both worlds: MemoryBO for rapid optimization, Kinetics360 for mechanistic understanding.


Those answer different questions. MemoryBO finds good conditions quickly, learning from your previous campaigns rather than starting from zero. Kinetics360 gives you a deeper understanding of the intrinsic kinetics and mechanisms.


The hardest part of kinetic modeling has always been starting from scratch. Propose a mechanism. Fit it. Decide whether the fit is real or whether you've just added parameters. Propose another.


Most teams never get past that, because it usually requires a kinetics specialist writing custom code. So the modeling waits on someone else's calendar.


Now we do that part for you.


Upload your time-series data and Kinetics360 automatically generates and ranks candidate kinetic models, balancing goodness of fit against complexity so the top model explains your data without overfitting it.


Then you can use it to simulate how the reaction behaves at temperatures, concentrations, and reaction times you haven't run.


Optimize conditions against competing objectives, such as maximizing yield while keeping an impurity below spec.


The video below walks through all three steps: upload your data, identify the model, simulate the outcomes.
